connectors.refdes: Sanguinololu 1.3a X endstop header · three positions
connectors.form: Three-position connector for 1.3a reference; do not substitute 1.3b2 four-position form
connectors.scope: The RepRap Sanguinololu page recommends connecting a mechanical switch C/NO to the two outside GND/SIG positions. Optical/proximity devices can use 5 V or supply voltage selected by the Stop Volt solder link. The page does not say which outside position is GND versus SIG. Its revision history says 1.3b2 replaced the three-pin endstop connector with a four-pin CD-ROM connector; that later revision is excluded here. This 1.3a board is only the Eventorbot design-BOM reference, not a verified installation.

evidence.primary: RepRap Eventorbot 1.2 parts list and RepRap Sanguinololu board documentation; design references only
evidence.scope_note: The Eventorbot BOM names motor, switch, heater, supply, and Sanguinololu 1.3a design groups but does not establish an installed unit or harness. Sanguinololu 1.3a contacts are a distinct reference-board device, not machine-side mating endpoints or SmoothieBox wiring instructions. Four-wire motor conductor indexes and 16-position carrier-socket slots are editorial/form indexes where stated; do not read them as connector-face geometry. Outside endstop contacts are GND/SIG as a set, but their left/right order is not published. Optional power inputs are alternatives, not simultaneous fitted connections. No routes or guesses are selected.
